summary: Third S3 adversarial round after the Green remediation 0dcc9ef1 at role base b6ae211f. The attack drove the new beforeAll sweep end to end: one child vitest run re-ran the real sweep over a full seed matrix, each row with a paired control. The core fix holds live: a stale folder of each seeded prefix class in the root, apps/integrated-math-3, and packages/app-shell is removed; the tracked-path guard keeps a folder that git names; a symlink is skipped and its target outside the repo survives; a file, a two-level-deep folder, and a no-dash name each stay; no mkdtempSync bypass of seedDir exists; and the r2 LEAKPROBE through adv 7 is green (the seeded .oxlint-adv13-LEAKPROBE3 carrier is swept before the test, and adv 7 passes). Two defects stay in the changed lines and report as blocking per the re-review scope. F1r3: the sweep reads only [REPO_ROOT, ...WORKSPACE_DIRS] (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:152), so the apps/ parent where makeLintProbe seeds .oxlint-probe-* (:1401), a class the F1r2 blast radius named, is not swept; live: apps/.oxlint-probe-R3STALE-iPK7Cx survived the child sweep; no current gate step reads that parent (gates.sh:95 skips dotfolders; adv 7 walks workspaces only at :1674), so the leak is litter today, not a red gate. F2r3: the prefix '.oxlint-adv' is broader than every seeded form (each continues with '-' or a digit), so the sweep deletes untracked near-miss folders; live: .oxlint-advisory-R3-homK7V and .oxlint-advisoryuMi3MP were removed, while the true no-dash name stayed. F2r2 and F3r2 stay accepted residuals (the r2 a and r2 d cases still pass and pin them; no CONTEST item was routed back). Re-checks at this HEAD: S3 adversarial 14 pass (12 of r1/r2 plus the new r3 a and r3 b), S3 tsrs 8 pass, S2 adversarial 13 pass, the gates-script file 23 pass, npx tsc --noEmit exit 0, the full scripts suite 86 pass with only the pre-existing remediate-concept-blueprints failure, and PROJECT_TESTS (gates.sh test s3 with resume, the scripts-suite step record dropped first) exit 0 NEWFAIL=0.
blocking_findings: F1r3 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the F1r2 remediation covers the root and each workspace but not the apps/ parent, where the suite still seeds leak-prone folders. sweepStaleProbeDirs reads only [REPO_ROOT, ...WORKSPACE_DIRS] (scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:152; WORKSPACE_DIRS at :1335 holds apps/* and packages/* workspaces, never apps/ itself), and makeLintProbe seeds .oxlint-probe-* under apps/ (:1401), the exact class the F1r2 blast radius named. Live proof: a seeded apps/.oxlint-probe-R3STALE-iPK7Cx/probe.ts survived the real beforeAll sweep (a child vitest run of the suite file), while the root, apps/integrated-math-3, and packages/app-shell seeds of both prefix classes were removed. Honest impact: no current gate step reads the apps/ parent one level (gates.sh:95 'for ws in apps/* packages/*' skips dotfolders; adv 7 walks WORKSPACE_DIRS only, oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:1674), so the leak is unremoved litter today, but the routed class stays unfixed and any future check that scans apps/ one level turns it red. Fix owner Green, one line: add path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'apps') to the sweep parent list. The committed r3 b pin flips to assert removal.

F2r3 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: the sweep prefix '.oxlint-adv' is broader than every seeded form, so the startup sweep deletes an untracked near-miss folder that no test seeded. Every seeded name continues with '-' or a digit (PROBE_DIR_PREFIXES at scripts/__tests__/oxc-toolchain-gates.test.ts:135), but the match is entry.name.startsWith('.oxlint-adv') (:156), which also matches .oxlint-advisory, .oxlint-advanced, and each similar name. Live proof: the seeded .oxlint-advisory-R3-homK7V and .oxlint-advisoryuMi3MP folders (one carrier file each, no user data) were removed by the real sweep, while the true no-dash form .oxlint-probe<rand> stayed. The sweep deletes untracked data without confirmation, and its comment says 'matches the exact prefix' (:149), so the behavior contradicts the comment. Both findings are defects in the lines that 0dcc9ef1 changed, so both report as blocking per the re-review scope. Fix owner Green, one line: require the character after '.oxlint-adv' to be '-' or a digit, or list the exact seeded prefixes. The committed r3 b advisory pin flips.
